mostWorthwhile.text: The fat sequence was most worthwhile: bile made smaller droplets, then enzymes broke the molecules apart. Seeing those as separate jobs helped me understand the process.

leastWorthwhile.text: The protein breakdown was clear but fairly predictable after the starch sequence; it felt like another direct enzyme pairing.

surprise.text: I hadn’t expected spreading fat into droplets and breaking the fat molecules to be two different steps.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary: the pictures showed what saliva, bile and the different enzymes could act on.
